[Shallow Learning (SL)](https://soulpageit.com/ai-glossary/shallow-learning-explained/)

[k-Nearest Neighbors (kNN)](https://rafalab.dfci.harvard.edu/dsbook-part-2/ml/resampling-methods.html#sec-knn-cv-intro) 
[Random Forest (RF)](https://rafalab.dfci.harvard.edu/dsbook-part-2/ml/algorithms.html#sec-random-forests) methods.


[Deep Learning (DL)](https://soulpageit.com/ai-glossary/deep-learning-explained/)

[Dense Neural Network (DNN)](https://smltar.com/dldnn) 

[Convolutional Neural Network (CNN)](https://smltar.com/dlcnn#what-are-cnns) 

--------------------
The ***DNN-Based*** models are as follows:

* ***DNN-Based Basic MCC Model:*** described in Section [Dense Neural Network-Based Basic Multiclass Classifier (DNNB MCC) Model];
* ***Tuned DNN-Based MCC Model:*** described in Section [Tuned DNN-Based (TDNN) MCC Model].

The last models we will build and explore, the ***CNN-Based*** models, are as follows:

* ***CNN-Based Basic MCC Model:*** described in Section [Convolutional Neural Network-Based Basic (CNNB) MCC Model];
* ***Tuned CNN-Based MCC Model:*** described in Section [Tuned CNN-Based (TCNN) MCC Model].

Finally, we will conduct a final test of the best model we have developed, using a specially designated dataset, and see what we will achieve.
